pages.text: You spent real effort tuning that bow. The $(l)Weapon Rack$() gives it somewhere to live.$(br2)Mount it on a wall like a torch, then right-click with a bow or crossbow to hang it. Right-click empty-handed to take it back down.
Three planks and two sticks for the pegs.

The rack shows the $(l)actual weapon$() you hang on it, so a cherry-limbed bow looks different to a dark oak one. Vanilla bows and crossbows work too.$(br2)Break the wall behind it and the rack falls, dropping whatever it was holding.
